name: Renegade Wine Bar (Bethnal Green)
summary: A wine bar and takeaway shop in Gales Gardens, run by Renegade Urban Winery.

music.notes: Wine and cheese pairing evenings on the first Wednesday of the month, and live music sessions from late afternoon.

evidence.quote: Book A Table | Bethnal Green (E2) — Renegade Urban Winery
every first Wednesday of the month you have the opportunity to learn how to perfectly pair wine and cheese
Live music from late afternoon, a glass of something good in hand
Renegade has been producing since early 2017
East London’s first urban winery, complete with taproom.
Situated in a railway arch this was the original site of Renegade Winery which moved to Walthamstow. Space was converted to a wine bar.

story.opened: Renegade began making wine in this railway arch in early 2017, according to Time Out.
story.then: The arch was the original home of Renegade Urban Winery, according to the CAMRA pub guide. The winemaking moved to Walthamstow and the space was converted into a wine bar.
story.now: The venue's own website says groups can enquire about hiring all or half of the arch, as well as private tastings and weddings or other special events.
worth_knowing: Time Out's 2017 review described it as the first urban winery in east London, with a taproom attached.

story_research.note: Used venue site, Time Out (2017) and CAMRA. No source found for when the winery became a wine bar, or a recent (post-2021) description of the room for vibe. Leads: DesignMyNight page, Londonist railway arches list (undated), local press on the Walthamstow move.
